answer_1.quote: Automatic text summarization is the task of automatically summarizing a long document into a relatively short text while preserving most of the information.
answer_1.outputs: extractive summaries (selected sentences from the source document)

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the performance of our model using F1 ROUGE, including ROUGE-1,2, and L for measuring unigram, bigram, and longest common subsequence.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation ... volunteers are asked to rank a pair of randomly ordered summaries produced by two models according to three criteria: non-redundancy, coverage, and overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: Volunteers rank the two model summaries based on non-redundancy, coverage, and overall quality compared to the reference summary.
